sourceNote: Historical trend data uses Bank of England quoted household mortgage-rate benchmarks. Current payment scenarios use the latest Moneyfacts whole-market fixed-rate averages stored in this file.
bandNote: 75% LTV benchmark is used at or below 75% LTV. Above 75%, the 95% LTV benchmark is used as a conservative planning proxy because the Bank of England publishes a directly comparable five-year quoted series at 75% and 95% LTV.

live.note: Average UK residential fixed mortgage rates across the market. Used for current payment scenarios only; not a personalised mortgage offer.
